payload.title: Tupelo Fire Department sets Station 5 grand opening for Oct. 28
payload.content:
The Tupelo Fire Department will hold a grand opening and dedication for Station 5 on Wednesday, Oct. 28, 2026, at 10 a.m. The event will be at 2667 S. Green Street in Tupelo. The department's original flyer lists a ribbon-cutting ceremony, station tours and refreshments.

Source: Tupelo Fire Department announcement and flyer

Correction (Oct. 27, 2026): An earlier version omitted the event details shown in the source flyer and incorrectly said joining details were unavailable.
